notes.V_mix_pooled: variance of all first-1000 M1 returns pooled over the 1000 paths of the bucket (includes between-path mean differences)
notes.V_mix_within_mean: mean over paths of the within-path variance of the first 1000 M1 returns
notes.VR_win: within-path overlapping variance ratio; VR_ens: cross-path variance of the 60h-step cumulative return / (60h x M1 variance)
